nights.name: Imminence
nights.extract: Imminence is a Swedish metalcore band formed in Trelleborg. The group consists of vocalist Eddie Berg, rhythm guitarist Harald Barrett, lead guitarist Alex Arnoldsson, and bassist Christian Höijer.

en.who: Imminence is a Swedish metalcore band. It was formed in Trelleborg.
